name: Return loss / VSWR
description: How well a device is matched to the line, with a vector network analyzer (VNA): return loss (S11) and VSWR against frequency, the best and worst match, the bands where the VSWR stays under a limit, the impedance at the best match, and a pass / fail check. For an antenna, an adapter, an attenuator, an amplifier input... The VNA is calibrated at the port beforehand by the user.

roles.name: vna
roles.description: The network analyzer, calibrated at the port the device connects to

sweep.description: start_hz, stop_hz, points, scale (linear|log), if_bandwidth_hz, power_dbm

device.description: label identifies the device under test; asset_id is its code in the registry of cables and devices

z0.description: reference impedance of the VNA (50 by default)

vswr_max.description: the bands where the VSWR is at most this are reported (2 by default)

frequencies_of_interest.description: return loss and VSWR are reported at these frequencies

limits.description: pass / fail limit on the return loss in dB, normally a minimum: {"min": 10}

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to calibrate and connect the device
